name: workatastartup
description: Y Combinator's Work at a Startup job board: search YC startup jobs by keyword and location, browse role and location listings, and read job and company pages including application links.

commands.name: search-jobs
commands.summary: Search YC startup jobs with a plain-language query, e.g. 'backend engineer in San Francisco'. Returns job id, title, company, location, salary, type and apply link.

params.name: q
params.description: Plain-language search over role, title, skills and location. Put the location in the text to filter by it, e.g. 'product manager San Francisco' or 'remote software engineer'. All matches come back in

commands.name: get-job
commands.summary: Get a job's page text: company, title, location, type, salary, equity, experience, visa and description. Use the id from search-jobs.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Numeric job id (the id field from search-jobs)

commands.name: get-company
commands.summary: Get a YC company's profile page text, including its batch and open jobs. Use the companySlug from search-jobs.

params.name: companySlug
params.description: Company slug (the companySlug field from search-jobs), e.g. getcrux

notes: search-jobs is the only structured JSON source; to filter by San Francisco (or any location), include the city in q.
applyUrl goes through account.ycombinator.com login; applying needs a YC account and cannot be done from this CLI.
Listing, job and company commands return page title plus full page text because those pages are rendered on the server.
